text:
olivia: quick report — intermittent parsing errors in sample-app when resuming SSE streams behind the dev proxy. sometimes the first bytes are nonprintable and events can arrive out-of-order.
rahul: do you have a raw snippet?
olivia: yes, from a local trace: 
[recv] 0x00 0x0a 0x7b 0x22 0x69 0x64  -> leading NUL + LF then '{"id"'
[recv] data: {"id":"a2","text":"second"}
[recv] data: {"id":"a1","text":"first"}
[parser] combined => '\u0000\n{"id":"a2","text":"second"}{"id":"a1","text":"first"}' -> json parse error
rahul: only seen in dev proxy or hits prod too?
olivia: dev proxy only; direct backend is clean. seems correlated with connection pooling + a concurrent tiny POST (auth refresh) that happens during reconnect.
rahul: ok can you add a minimal repro server in sample-app? i.e. write seq 2 then seq 1 with a tiny interleave.
olivia: added repro under sample-app/streaming/repro.md and a node snippet: ```res.write('data: {"id":"a2","text":"second"}\n\n'); setTimeout(()=>res.write('data: {"id":"a1","text":"first"}\n\n'), 1);```
rahul: short-term client patch: buffer incoming bytes until full SSE delimiter ("\n\n") before splitting events, and trim leading control bytes (<=0x1f) before parsing. emit telemetry when trimming so we don't silently hide infra issues.
olivia: implemented a local feature-flagged patch that trims leading nonprintables and buffers until delimiter; fixed flakiness in my runs. will open PR.
infra-bot: INF-1422 created: "dev-proxy: investigate pooled connection writes causing leading control bytes / out-of-order SSE fragments". please attach pcap on next repro.
sam: SDK PR should include unit tests for: leading-control-byte trimming, interleaved-write harness, and preserving SSE comments/retry lines. also add a small optional reorder buffer keyed by id/seq (N=8, timeout 200ms) disabled by default.
olivia: will add tests + telemetry counters sse.trim_bytes and sse.reorder_events. attaching repro and logs to DEX-1567.
devex-bot: Created DEX-1567 "streaming: defensive resume parsing + infra pcap triage".
rahul: thanks — let's keep the infra ticket open and monitor telemetry after the SDK flag rollout.
